sources.title: WhiteFiber Q3 2026 Form 10-Q, Canadian colocation operations and development
sources.summary: WhiteFiber attributed third-quarter revenue to its operating MTL-3 facility. It reported planning at its MTL-2 conversion and still expected construction to start in the fourth quarter.

extraction.source_distribution: WhiteFiber investor relations SEC filings archive.
extraction.mtl1: The issuer describes its leased Montréal HPC facility as 4 MW gross. Its statement of full operation at acquisition refers specifically to October 2024.
extraction.mtl2: Third-quarter planning started on the 160,000-square-foot former manufacturing building. The targeted initial project is 5 MW gross. Construction was still described as a future fourth-quarter start.
extraction.mtl3: In the quarter ended September 30, MTL-3 generated revenue. The seven-gross-MW property is approximately 202,000 square feet on 7.7 acres. Cerebras contracts for five MW of IT load. The acquisition closed May 8, 2026, following the commencement of colocation billing in November 2025.
